notes: What can be sold and which limits each plan lifts. Prices are not here: staff set them at /admin/billing, and nothing is on sale until they do. Removing a product or feature deactivates it (rows are never deleted, so old payments keep their product).

features.description: Partner service areas that receive referrals
Referrals included each month without a lead fee

products.name: Professional review: planning
products.description: A qualified professional, such as a town planner, checks one planning assessment, corrects what doesn't fit and tells you what to do next.

products.name: Professional review: vessel
products.description: A qualified professional, such as a marine surveyor, checks one vessel assessment and tells you what to do next.

products.name: Professional review: business approvals
products.description: A qualified professional checks one business approval map and tells you what to do next.

products.name: Professional review: grants
products.description: A grant professional checks one grant eligibility assessment and tells you what to do next.

products.name: Professional review: selling
products.description: A qualified professional checks one sale assessment and tells you what to do next.

products.name: Professional review: renting
products.description: A qualified professional checks one rental assessment and tells you what to do next.

products.name: Professional review: importing and exporting
products.description: A qualified professional, such as a licensed customs broker, checks one import or export approval map and tells you what to do next.

products.name: RentReady Manage
products.description: Manage up to 10 rental properties: listings, applications, tenancies, inspections and reminders.

products.name: RentReady Manage Plus
products.description: Manage any number of rental properties.

products.name: Partner Standard
products.description: Be referred in up to 3 categories across up to 15 service areas, with up to 5 people in your account and 15 referrals a month without a lead fee.

products.name: Partner Pro
products.description: Be referred in every category you are approved for, in any number of service areas, with up to 20 people in your account and 50 referrals a month without a lead fee.

products.name: Lead credits
products.description: Prepaid credit for lead fees (referrals beyond your plan's monthly allowance). You get credit equal to what you pay.
